newsitem.title: UK: Railtrack off on London Underground report.
newsitem.headline: Railtrack off on London Underground report.

text.p: Shares in Railtrack Plc dropped on Tuesday on profit-taking sparked by a report that the operator of the UK rail network planned a bid for London's underground railway system if the latter is privatised, dealers said.
The stock, which more than doubled after its privatisation last May to reach a record 429p on January 16, was down 12p at 369 by 0941 GMT.
"The stock was a bit spooked by the story in the Times which brought in a few sellers at their higher levels," said one market-maker.

A report in the Times newspaper said Railtrack chairman Robert Horton had told the UK government that only a company of Railtrack's size could afford the one billion stg investment needed to upgrade the underground system.
